Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix House committee and member XML parsing

- Update committee parser to handle ROOT.Committee structure
- Parse committee members to extract Chair and Vice-Chair
- Update member parser to fetch individual district XML files
- Fix RawMemberDetail interface to handle ROOT wrapper
- Fix type coercion for district numbers \(String\(\).padStart\)
- Fix rate limiter to properly wait for concurrent request slots
- Add progress logging for House bill sync

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Sync House legislative data: committees, members, and bills

Database now contains:
- 65 committees \(62 House committees with chair/vice-chair\)
- 160 members \(158 House representatives with contact info\)
- 2,285 bills \(1,485 House + 795 Senate\)
- 8,775 legislative actions

Data synced from official Missouri House XML feeds:
- https://documents.house.mo.gov/xml/261-CommitteeList.XML
- https://documents.house.mo.gov/xml/261-MemberList.XML
- https://documents.house.mo.gov/xml/261-BillList.XML

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
